biography: Gary Wager, a name whispered with a mix of awe and apprehension in Ginetta circles, hails from a small village nestled in the heart of the British countryside. Unlike many racers who grew up karting from toddlerhood, Gary's introduction to motorsport was almost accidental. At 16, while helping his father restore a classic Mini Cooper, he stumbled upon a local hill climb event. The roar of engines and the scent of burning rubber ignited a passion he never knew existed. He spent his savings on a battered Ginetta G40, entering local club races. His aggressive, no-holds-barred style quickly made him a talking point. A defining moment came at Brands Hatch in 2022 when, despite starting from the back of the grid after a qualifying mishap, he clawed his way to victory, overtaking three cars in the final corner. Now, at 21, Gary is a rising star, his raw talent undeniable, although his aggressive nature sometimes lands him in hot water. He's currently working his way up the Ginetta ladder, with ambitions set firmly on GT racing.
drivingStyle: Gary's driving style is characterized by relentless aggression and a willingness to push the limits of his car and his rivals. He's known for late braking and daring overtaking maneuvers, often diving down the inside where others wouldn't dare. While his tire management is still a work in progress, he compensates with raw speed and relentless pressure. Under pressure, Gary tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes to his detriment, but often resulting in spectacular displays of car control and sheer determination.

rivalries.name: James Thornton
rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and racing styles. Thornton, known for his calculated approach, publicly criticized Gary's aggressive tactics, leading to several on-track incidents.

rivalries.name: Sophia Rossi
rivalries.reason: Rossi and Wager have been neck-and-neck throughout their Ginetta careers, often battling for podium positions, resulting in intense, close-fought races and a simmering rivalry.

rivalries.name: Ben Carter
rivalries.reason: Carter and Wager competed in a Ginetta Junior championship that lead to a last-lap incident that cost both drivers the championship.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, even if they have holes in them.
Listens to heavy metal music at an ear-splitting volume before every race to psych himself up.
Has a small, worn-out teddy bear named 'Turbo' that he keeps in his race bag and occasionally talks to.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I'm here to win, and I'll do whatever it takes."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brands Hatch Ginetta race in 2022 after starting from the back of the grid. This victory showcased his raw talent and cemented his reputation as a driver to watch.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2023 Ginetta GT4 SuperCup race at Donington Park due to over-aggression, costing him valuable championship points.
